question: Which of the following was NOT an outcome of the Green Revolution?

options.text: High dependency on chemical fertilisers and pesticides

solution:
The correct answer is __**Decrease in rural population**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Decrease in rural population** was not an outcome of the Green Revolution; the rural population remained largely stable during this period.
 
• The Green Revolution led to a significant **increase in food grain production**, particularly in wheat and rice, ensuring self-sufficiency in food for India.
 
• A key result of the Green Revolution was the **high dependency on chemical fertilizers and pesticides** to boost agricultural yields.
 
• It also promoted the development of **improved agricultural infrastructure**, including irrigation systems, roads, and storage facilities.
 
• The Green Revolution primarily benefited regions with access to irrigation, leading to regional disparities in agricultural growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Green Revolution:** A series of initiatives introduced in the mid-20th century to increase agricultural productivity in India using high-yield variety (HYV) seeds, chemical fertilizers, and advanced irrigation techniques.
 
• **High-Yield Variety Seeds:** These seeds were a cornerstone of the Green Revolution and significantly increased the production of wheat and rice.
 
• **Impact on Farmers:** While larger farmers benefitted significantly, small-scale farmers often struggled with the cost of fertilizers, pesticides, and machinery.
 
• **Environmental Effects:** The intensive use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides led to soil degradation, water pollution, and reduced biodiversity in some areas.
 
• **Regional Disparities:** The Green Revolution had a limited impact on rain-fed areas and regions without proper irrigation infrastructure, such as eastern and southern India.
